translation_en: Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us: Al-Layth narrated to us, from ‘Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab. Ahmad ibn Salih narrated to us: ‘Anbasah narrated to us: Yunus narrated to us, from Ibn Shihab, who said: ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn Ka‘b ibn Malik informed me that ‘Abd Allah ibn Ka‘b, who used to lead Ka‘b when he became blind, said: I heard Ka‘b ibn Malik give his full account of staying behind from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, on the expedition to Tabuk. Ibn Bukayr added in his report: I witnessed the Night of al-‘Aqabah with the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, when we pledged firmly to follow Islam. I would not trade being present there for being present at Badr, even though Badr is more widely remembered among people.
